parameters.query:
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(ii.btw_rate)=21 THEN ii.quantity*ii.unit_price ELSE 0 END),0) AS omzet_21,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(ii.btw_rate)=9  THEN ii.quantity*ii.unit_price ELSE 0 END),0) AS omzet_9,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(ii.btw_rate)=0  THEN ii.quantity*ii.unit_price ELSE 0 END),0) AS omzet_0,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(ii.btw_rate)=21 THEN ii.btw_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS btw_omzet_21,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(ii.btw_rate)=9  THEN ii.btw_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS btw_omzet_9,
  COUNT(DISTINCT i.invoice_number) AS factuur_count
FROM invoice_items ii
JOIN invoices i ON i.invoice_number=ii.invoice_number
WHERE i.status='verzonden'
  AND YEAR(i.date)={{ $json.jaar }}
  AND ({{ $json.kwartaal_nr }}=0 OR QUARTER(i.date)={{ $json.kwartaal_nr }})
  AND ({{ $json.maand_nr }}=0 OR MONTH(i.date)={{ $json.maand_nr }})

parameters.query:
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(btw_percentage)=21 THEN amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS kosten_21,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(btw_percentage)=9  THEN amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS kosten_9,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(btw_percentage)=0  THEN amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS kosten_0,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(btw_percentage)=21 THEN btw_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS btw_kosten_21,
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ROUND(btw_percentage)=9  THEN btw_amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS btw_kosten_9,
  COUNT(*) AS inkoop_count
FROM expenses
WHERE YEAR(date)={{ $json.jaar }}
  AND ({{ $json.kwartaal_nr }}=0 OR QUARTER(date)={{ $json.kwartaal_nr }})
  AND ({{ $json.maand_nr }}=0 OR MONTH(date)={{ $json.maand_nr }})
